summary: Every one of the 24 acceptance criteria has delivered work behind it. P1 covers V12–V13, P2 covers V20, and P3–P5 cover V01–V11, V15–V19, V22 and V24; P7 plus A3 cover V21, the pre-run KubeCoder commit plus A1 cover V14, and V23 holds because Charts has no commits and no phase targets KubeCoder. The missing P6 was dropped deliberately by plan-review ruling F1, and no done-record or ruling leaves work that a later phase depended on. The remaining findings (B1, S2–S4, S6–S11) are advisory, belong to slices 012/014, or are gate hardening no AC asks for, so they stay in the close-out; S1 and S11 got routing notes. S5 was mechanical comment residue, fixed in KubeCoderDeploy 021cc1b with lint and test green, and struck.
